Firmware update

Install the hardware-tested Brick Breaker build or restore official v1.0.38 through the TD-H9 vendor HID recovery mode. The game package downloads from H9 Toolbox and is checked against its exact tested hash. Your radio backup stays in your browser and is never uploaded.

Before you begin

This path has restored changed sectors on one TD-H9, but a complete browser firmware update has not yet been verified on hardware. A failed update can leave the radio unable to boot. Keep a reliable recovery method available.

Before writing, create and save a recovery backup here or select a raw main-flash backup. The HID backup reconstructs the accessible flash using CRC queries; it can take several minutes. HID cannot read or write the protected first 0x5000 bytes. A Bluetooth channel .img is not a firmware recovery backup.

Brick Breaker requires the exact stock v1.0.38 main image. The page refuses to install it over another build. If you update older firmware to v1.0.38, recheck channels and settings afterward.

01

Select firmware and backup

Brick Breaker for stock v1.0.38Downloads the exact tested package and checks its SHA-256 before any radio access.

No firmware package selected

You can select a backup before or after firmware. Brick Breaker installation requires a backup matching exact stock v1.0.38. A raw .bin backup checks protected boot bytes. An HID archive contains accessible bytes from 0x5000 onward and an integrity hash; protected boot bytes are unavailable through HID.

02

Connect USB HID

Disconnected
  1. Turn the radio off and connect a data-capable USB-C cable.
  2. Hold PTT + 2 while powering on. The screen stays blank and the top LED turns green.
  3. Click Connect and select the JieLi HID device in the browser chooser.
Select a firmware target and connect the radio first.

The radio must stay in HID mode throughout backup. The page checks each reconstructed sector and rescans the radio before accepting the archive. Confirm the download is saved before proceeding.

03

Inspect and update

Inspect reads sector CRCs only. No erase or write is sent until you explicitly start the update.

Select firmware, save a recovery backup, and connect the radio.

Restore writes the saved application sectors back through HID and checks their CRCs. The HID archive also preserves accessible settings bytes above 0xDA000, but this page does not write those settings or the protected boot region.

0%

Activity

Ready. No radio write has been sent.
